obligation: When the arrow key is let go, the robot stops almost straight away. Walking right for half a second and then letting go for a full second must leave the robot more than 75 px short of where walking right for a whole second takes it. On the clean game it is 150 px short (it stops within a tick of release); 75 px is half of what half a second of walking covers, so a slide of more than 75 px after release fails. Chosen from the clean game and the report's 'stops almost straight away', before any replay of the defect.

probes.description: Hold move_right for half a second, then let go and stand for one second.
Hold move_right for one second, then one tick standing.

candidates.statement: Letting go after half a second of walking leaves the robot more than 75 px short of where a whole second of walking takes it.
